## Load 
```{r }
zsumm<-fread("/oak/stanford/groups/smontgom/raungar/Sex/Output/analysis_v8/continuous/Ranks/aut_beta0.111_all_summary.txt")
# colnames(zsumm)<-c("ind","min","iqr1","med","ave","iqr3","max","tissue","sex")
zsumm<-zsumm[,-1]
colnames(zsumm)<-c("ind","sex","min","iqr1","med","ave","iqr3","max")
zsumm$rank<-rank(zsumm$med)
ggplot(zsumm,aes(x=ind,y=med,color=sex))+
   geom_errorbar(aes(ymax =iqr1, ymin = iqr3),position = "dodge")+
  geom_point()+
  scale_color_manual(values=c("#F0CE22","#7CCBEA"))+
 # geom_boxplot(aes(lower = iqr1, upper = iqr3,middle=med,ymin=min, ymax=max),stat="identity")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,color="red")

```
